neighbours.label: Weak guess: the first piece ' com' of a word (com|ings and goings, com|ically); plain words stay low
fire: Blame the constant comings and goings of the staff.
He appeared on stage, comically waving a large spoon.
Both teams saw many comings and goings in summer.
The actor comically tripped over the same chair.
We watched the comings and goings at the port.
She shook her fist comically at the dog.
Comings and goings at the palace were noted daily.
The cat comically fell off the sofa.
quiet: Blame the constant noise and dust of the road.
He appeared on stage, slowly waving a large spoon.
Both teams saw many injuries in summer.
The actor nearly tripped over the same chair.
We watched the ships and boats at the port.
She shook her fist angrily at the dog.
Visitors at the palace were noted daily.
The cat quietly fell asleep on the sofa.

notes: Card only, not probed. Other top tokens (Arabic, Russian, Japanese pieces, ' cache') are not covered.
